question: A bakery bakes bagels and croissants. A batch of bagels can be made using 2 hours of oven time and 0.25 hours of pastry chef time. A batch of croissants is more complicated, so while they take 1 hour of oven time, they take 2 hours of pastry chef time. In a day, the bakery has at most 70 hours available for the oven and 32 pastry chef hours available. Using all the available capacity, what is the maximum profit the bakery can generate assuming the profit per batch is $20 and $40 respectively for a batch of bagels and a batch of croissants.

import pyomo.environ as pyo

DATA = {
    "PRODUCTS": ["bagels", "croissants"],
    "RESOURCES": ["oven", "pastry_chef"],
    # oven hours per batch
    "oven_hours": {"bagels": 2.0, "croissants": 1.0},
    # pastry chef hours per batch
    "chef_hours": {"bagels": 0.25, "croissants": 2.0},
    # daily capacity in hours per resource
    "capacity": {"oven": 70.0, "pastry_chef": 32.0},
    # profit per batch
    "profit": {"bagels": 20.0, "croissants": 40.0},
}


def build_model(data=None):
    d = data or DATA
    model = pyo.ConcreteModel()

    model.I = pyo.Set(initialize=d["PRODUCTS"])
    model.J = pyo.Set(initialize=d["RESOURCES"])

    # hours consumed per batch of product i on resource j
    def usage_rule(m, j, i):
        if j == "oven":
            return d["oven_hours"][i]
        return d["chef_hours"][i]

    model.usage = pyo.Param(model.J, model.I, initialize=usage_rule)

    # Decision variables: batches produced, nonnegative reals
    model.x = pyo.Var(model.I,
                      domain=pyo.NonNegativeReals,
                      bounds=(0.0, None))

    # Objective: maximise total profit
    def obj_rule(m):
        return sum(d["profit"][i] * m.x[i] for i in m.I)

    model.obj = pyo.Objective(rule=obj_rule, sense=pyo.maximize)

    # Capacity per resource (hours available)
    model.cap = pyo.Param(model.J, initialize=lambda m, j: d["capacity"][j])

    # Constraint: piece-of-capacity-used sentences
    # Using all the available capacity -> resources used equal capacity
    def capacity_rule(m, j):
        return sum(m.usage[j, i] * m.x[i] for i in m.I) == m.cap[j]

    model.capacity_limit = pyo.Constraint(model.J, rule=capacity_rule)

    return model

    # --- Variables ---

    model.x = pyo.Var(model.P, domain=pyo.NonNegativeReals)

    def obj_rule(m):
        return sum(d["profit"][p] * m.x[p] for p in m.P)

    model.obj = pyo.Objective(rule=obj_rule, sense=pyo.maximize)

    # --- Constraints (one rule per atomic sentence) ---
    # Sentence: "Using all the available capacity ..." (oven) -> equality
    def oven_rule(m):
        return sum(d["oven_hours"][p] * m.x[p] for p in m.P) == d["oven_capacity"]

    model.oven_capacity = pyo.Constraint(rule=oven_rule)

    # Sentence: "Using all the available capacity ..." (pastry chef) -> equality
    def chef_rule(m):
        return sum(d["chef_hours"][p] * m.x[p] for p in m.P) == d["chef_capacity"]

    model.chef_capacity = pyo.Constraint(rule=chef_rule)

    return model
